messages.author: e1b933a0d5bbe14f
messages.subject: Changing the language of R
parts:
After a virus infection, the university has insisted I use their licensed version of Korean Windows, so of course R now runs in Korean as well. The commands are input in English but all the messages back to me are in Korean. How can I change it to English, bearing in mind that all my menus and everything are in Korean as well? (I can read Korean well enough to know there's no menu option for adjusting the language, but not enough to understand all the errors I get--Heck, I don't even always understand them in English.)

--
Kevin Parent, Ph.D, ACB, ALB
Korea Maritime University

National Korea Toastmasters: http://grou.ps/koreatoastmasters

seoksung instead of properties.
